Container.Name: Anchorr
Container.Overview: Discord bot for requesting movies and TV shows via Seerr and posting notifications when new content arrives in your Jellyfin library. Configure everything in the web dashboard after the first start.
Container.Requires: A running Jellyfin server and Seerr (Jellyseerr) instance, plus a Discord bot token.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web dashboard and the Jellyfin webhook endpoint.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores config.json and notification state. Required, or settings are lost on container updates.

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Address the dashboard listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0, otherwise the WebUI is unreachable.
